aiHintsLegend.message: In the model dropdowns the cheapest models are green and the next cheapest yellow.

aiHintsNote.message: As of $date$, from the providers' price pages. Prices change: the provider's own page is what counts.

aiHint_claude.message: The Haiku models are the cheapest. Sonnet costs about twice as much, Opus about four times.

aiHint_openai.message: The nano models are the cheapest, then the mini models. The full-size models cost several times more.

aiHint_gemini.message: The Flash-Lite models are the cheapest, then Flash. Pro costs the most.

aiHint_mistral.message: The Ministral and Small models are the cheapest. Large costs a few times more, Medium the most.

aiHint_groq.message: The open gpt-oss models are the cheapest, the smaller one first. The Llama models have no public price (Contact Sales).

aiHint_deepseek.message: Flash is the cheap model, Pro costs three to four times as much. Outside the peak hours everything costs half.

aiHint_openrouter.message: The price depends on the model and on the host that serves it. Models marked ":free" cost nothing (with limits).

aiHint_ollama.message: Runs on your own computer: no cost per token.
